slides.title:
The chef wrote
the book. Literally.
slides.body:
The Jang Trio has anchored the Mingles menu for years — three Korean ferments most people meet in stews and side dishes, served as the last course instead of the first.

It isn't a gimmick. Chef Mingoo Kang, who opened Mingles in 2014 after training under Martin Berasategui in San Sebastián, published "Jang: The Soul of Korean Cooking" in 2024 — a whole book on doenjang, ganjang and gochujang. It won the James Beard Foundation Book Award 2025 in the Single Subject category.

The restaurant is the argument; the book is the footnotes.
